official_sources.name: ESPN golf scoreboard JSON (season calendar)
fields_provided: season calendar with event ids and dates

official_sources.name: PGA TOUR strokes gained (ShotLink)
fields_provided: SG approach, off the tee, around the green, putting, tee-to-green, total (season averages)

official_sources.name: Open-Meteo forecast
fields_provided: daily wind, rain probability, temperature; hourly wind for round-one trend

official_sources.name: OLBG golf tips index
fields_provided: event names, market names, tipster consensus counts (display only)

irregularities.title: No free odds source
irregularities.detail: Neither ESPN (odds object absent on every golf event inspected) nor OLBG server HTML publishes golf prices. The prompt's value rules that reference market favourites are applied using OWGR rank within the field instead, and that substitution is named in every value flag.
irregularities.mitigation: Odds never synthesised; recorded in missing[] on every market.

irregularities.title: Strokes gained is only free for the PGA TOUR and only as season averages
irregularities.detail: The PGA TOUR stat pages publish season-to-date strokes gained (ShotLink). No free source publishes per-event or last-eight-events strokes gained, and none exists for the DP World Tour. The pages are JavaScript-rendered, so the parser is best-effort.
irregularities.mitigation: Season averages stand in for the eight-event window and the substitution is stated in the component detail; when unparseable the three SG categories score zero and are marked missing, which caps confidence at MEDIUM.

irregularities.title: Course type and grass are not published
irregularities.detail: ESPN publishes yardage and par only; no free source classifies links/parkland/coastal/desert or bentgrass/bermuda.
irregularities.mitigation: A measurable yardage class (short/mid/long) replaces course type; links bonuses in the regional markets are left unassessed and listed as missing.

irregularities.title: Course history is limited to the seasons in the tape
irregularities.detail: The results tape covers the current and previous season(s) collected by this script. "Last four appearances" may therefore be one or two appearances for most players.
irregularities.mitigation: History is scored only from the editions present; when no prior edition exists the whole category is marked missing.

irregularities.title: Name matching between ESPN, OWGR and PGA TOUR is by normalised name
irregularities.detail: The three sources use different player ids. Names are normalised (diacritics, punctuation, suffixes) and ambiguous keys are discarded.
irregularities.mitigation: Unmatched players simply lack a ranking or SG row and score those categories as missing; the coverage panel shows how many matched.

irregularities.title: Round-one weather trend is a forecast
irregularities.detail: The first-round-leader tee-time rule depends on whether conditions deteriorate during day one. The trend is computed from Open-Meteo hourly wind and rain across the tee-time window and is only collected inside seven days of the event.
irregularities.mitigation: Absent forecasts leave the category missing (0 points) rather than assumed.

irregularities.title: Amateurs are excluded
irregularities.detail: Amateurs cannot win prize money and are usually not priced; ESPN flags them.
irregularities.mitigation: Excluded from every market and listed in the card flags.

irregularities.title: LPGA and Champions Tour are shown but not scored
irregularities.detail: The prompt's regional markets and OWGR ranking rules apply to the men's tours; the LPGA uses a different ranking and the Champions Tour is not ranked by OWGR.
irregularities.mitigation: Their leaderboards and calendars appear on the golf page; no tips are written.
